# TryMetaClear

> TryMetaClear is a free online tool that shows and removes hidden metadata from images and videos: EXIF, GPS, IPTC, XMP, AI-generation fields (prompts, model names, digital source type) and C2PA Content Credentials. Metadata is removed with ExifTool without re-encoding pixels or video streams. It does not remove pixel-level watermarks such as SynthID.

Key facts:
- Free, no account required. Images: PNG, JPG, WebP, HEIC up to 100 MB. Video: MP4, MOV, WebM up to 100 MB.
- Uploaded files are processed in memory and deleted after the cleaned copy is returned; no copies are kept.
- Built by Mayank Gupta. Contact: support@trymetaclear.com

## Tools and guides

- [AI Metadata & EXIF Remover](https://trymetaclear.com/): Main tool. Scan an image, see AI-related fields flagged, download a clean copy.
- [How to Remove AI Metadata from an Image](https://trymetaclear.com/remove-ai-metadata-from-image): Four methods compared (online tool, ExifTool, screenshot, OS settings) and what each removes.
- [Remove C2PA Content Credentials](https://trymetaclear.com/remove-c2pa-content-credentials): What C2PA is, where it is stored in JPEG/PNG/WebP, who adds and reads it, and how to remove it.
- [Remove Midjourney Metadata](https://trymetaclear.com/remove-midjourney-metadata): The prompt, Job ID and Author fields Midjourney stores, and how to remove them.
- [Remove DALL-E & ChatGPT Metadata](https://trymetaclear.com/remove-dall-e-metadata): The C2PA manifest OpenAI adds to generated images, and how to remove it.
- [Video AI Metadata Remover](https://trymetaclear.com/remove-video-ai-metadata): Removes AI tags and C2PA from MP4, MOV and WebM without re-encoding.
